endpoint.source_contract: Same public UDF history endpoint used by scripts/fetch_nobitex_public_ohlcv.py

window.timestamp_semantics: Inclusive candle-open timestamps; both start and end grid points are required.

pagination.ordering: Sort collected candles by timestamp ascending before exact-grid validation.
pagination.duplicates: Deduplicate exact timestamp keys; report duplicate count in structural metadata.

prehack_reference.policy: Post-hack start must be strictly greater than the final pre-hack candle-open timestamp; no timestamp overlap is permitted.

gap_policy.name: ZERO_TOLERANCE
gap_policy.gap_artifact: Full list of missing UTC timestamps and Unix timestamps; no candle values.

grid_convention: hourly candles timestamped at :30 UTC (Iran UTC+3:30 local hour boundaries)
revision_reason: structural: prehack dataset and adjacent-window DIAGNOSE both on :30 grid; nominal window unchanged; not a window shift
